column1: # Rule: function, filter and workflow are a function, at any depth, recorded
# under the bare name: `function script:Get-Item` is Get-Item, because that is
# how it is called (the scope modifiers global:, script:, local: and private:
# are removed). class and enum are a class; a method or constructor of a class
# is a method. Not definitions: class properties, enum members, parameters,
# variables, the base class in `class Dog : Animal`, calls.

# module.ps1 and tabexpansion.ps1: `function script:name`, global:, private:, filter, workflow, a function after a here-string and a switch. Dsc.ps1: DSC `Configuration` is a function; class properties and enum members are not recorded.
